title: Reliability Initiative: Deployment Compatibility Matrix for SLO & Error-Budget Allocation
creator: Elena Morales
description:
Problem statement: Redwood offers hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployment modes with subtly different performance profiles, observability coverage, and rollback/patching semantics. Teams currently struggle to: 1) reason about SLO parity across deployments, 2) allocate error budget fairly when customers are on different deployment types, and 3) automate rollout/fallback policies that respect deployment-specific constraints.

Goal: Produce a canonical Deployment Compatibility Matrix and a concrete runbook for translating SLI targets and error-budget tranches across hosted/dedicated/private deployments. The deliverable will include a published matrix, a Console dashboard visualizing per-deployment SLI and burn, and a decision automation spec to be picked up by eng for implementation.

Scope (in-scope):
- Inventory existing SLI collection points and differences by deployment mode (latency histograms, p99/p95, token-level errors, model fallback counts).
- Define compatibility categories (Full-parity, Reduced-telemetry, Conservative-SLO) and mapping rules for translating SLOs and error-budget allowances.
- Create per-customer tranche suggestion rules for Dedicated customers (reserved capacity) vs Hosted customers.
- Draft runbook for operational responses when a trimmed deployment causes cross-customer burn (escalation thresholds, temporary throttles, automatic model variant fallback).
- Wire up a Console dashboard prototype that surfaces compliance state and burn attribution by deployment.
- Produce acceptance criteria, test plan, and rollout checklist for engineering to implement automation.

Out-of-scope: enforcement implementation, deep infra changes to telemetry collectors, or changes to pricing models.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Compatibility Matrix published in Confluence and linked from Console help; categories and translation rules agreed by SRE, Runtime, and PM.
2) Console dashboard prototype shows per-deployment SLI (latency p95/p99, error rate, emitted tokens) and per-deployment error-budget burn for last 7/30 days.
3) Automated suggestion engine spec for Dedicated tranche sizing completed and reviewed.
4) Runbook with explicit escalation steps and playbook templates validated in tabletop with two oncall squads.
5) Stakeholder sign-off (SRE lead, Runtime Tech Lead, Director of PM).
success_metrics:
- Published matrix adopted as the canonical reference (tracked via doc views + link from onboarding).
- Reduction in ambiguous reliability escalations for mixed-deployment incidents (target: 50% fewer cross-deployment handoffs in next quarter).
- Dedicated customers receive tranche suggestions with at least 80% uptake when recommended.
- Dashboard adoption: 70% of SRE/ops checks include per-deployment burn visualization within first month.
